name: pg_num2int_direct_comp
abstract: Exact comparison operators between numeric/float and integer types, with index use
description: Stock PostgreSQL compares an integer column with a numeric or float value by casting the column, which defeats its index, or by casting the value, which can give a wrong answer. This extension adds exact cross-type comparison operators for int2/int4/int8 against numeric, float4 and float8, joins them to the btree and hash operator families, and rewrites comparisons with a constant into native integer predicates so indexes, merge joins and hash joins apply.
